caption: The drawing depicts an octagonal object viewed from above, centered on a light beige background with a double-lined rectangular border. The center of the object is filled with a solid black area, forming an octagonal shape. Surrounding this black center is a thicker brown frame that is also octagonal, with each of the eight sides containing different decorative rectangular panels. Four alternate sides of the frame feature panels with intricate dark brown scroll and foliage patterns, while the other four panels consist of framed rectangular sections, two of which contain symmetrical naturalistic designs resembling stylized foliage. The entire composition is rendered in shades of brown, black, and beige, using ink and watercolor techniques, and the drawing is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Top of Table
